spec.claim_summary: Go long on 4H Supertrend flip to uptrend with ATR stop, partial take at 0.75R to breakeven and final exit on flip to downtrend.
assumptions: BTCUSD mapped to BTCUSDT spot for testing.
Supertrend settings not stated, so used ATR length 10 and multiplier 3.0 as defaults; same settings for entry and exit.
ATR stop-loss multiple and ATR length not stated, so used 2.0 x ATR(14) with ATR taken at the signal bar.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: partial exit closing half the position at 0.75R cannot be expressed; the 0.75R target was omitted so the full position is held to the opposite Supertrend flip to avoid cutting the runner short.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: moving the stop loss to breakeven after the 0.75R half-close cannot be expressed; the spec keeps the original ATR stop throughout.
Backtest window cited by claimant recorded in claimed; engine tests over all available history starting flat.
Rules evaluated on bar closes with fill at next bar open.

evidence.quote: you enter into a long position.
Once Supertrend changes from a downtrend to a uptrend, you enter into a long position.
Once Supertrend changes from a uptrend to a downtrend, you close the other half of the initial long position.
The stop loss will be defined by the atr stop loss

audit_majors: take_profit_r: Claim requires first profit at 0.75 risk/reward where half position will be closed; spec sets take_profit_r to null and holds the full position to the opposite Supertrend flip.
stop_atr_mult: Claim requires moving the stop loss to breakeven after the 0.75R half-close; spec keeps the original ATR stop throughout with no breakeven move.
